program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready file at the sampled establishment level for a single reference period, by merging raw collected microdata with a control file, applying a retention filter, and writing the result to a caller-specified library; also aggregates totals by state_fips for review.

macro_reference.name: dostep9
macro_reference.purpose: Merges D1 and D2 to produce O1 for reference period `p`, applying a 3-step pipeline (sort/merge, summarize, transpose).

variable_dictionary.label: Establishment identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: PER

variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &dt macro variable set at the top of the program.
